summary: Iter 43 — Daily Wellness Feed detail route verified end-to-end. Backend GET /api/feed and GET /api/feed/{id} (with related siblings and 404 for missing) work correctly: 7/7 pytest assertions pass. Frontend: patient login → Feed tab → tapping tip/remedy/yoga cards opens /feed-item/[id] with correct title (testID feed-detail-title), category badge, hero image and body. feed-detail-back returns to /feed. 'More like this' related items (feed-related-{id}) navigate to that item. Blog chip regression intact — tapping a feed-blog-{id} card still opens /blog/<slug>. Chip filtering (remedy→2, yoga→1, tip→3, all→6) also works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: app/feed-item/[id].tsx uses router.replace() when navigating between related items. This means the user cannot step back through the chain of related items — pressing back always lands on /feed. If stacked exploration is desired, use router.push() for related items. Not a bug per the review spec, but worth confirming with product.

Testing artifact (not a product bug): Playwright page.click(..., force=True) does NOT trigger React-Native-Web TouchableOpacity.onPress for chips inside the horizontal ScrollView — a bare DOM .click() does. Real touch/mouse interactions behave normally. If future tests cover chip taps, prefer page.evaluate(() => el.click()) or page.tap() on this screen.
seed_data_creation: Registered a disposable patient account iter43_patient_1792116355@test.com / Test@123456 (role=patient) via POST /api/auth/register for Feed UI testing. No other seed data added — feed items 1-6 already exist in MySQL via msdb.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feed detail route is /feed-item/[id]. Backend endpoint GET /api/feed/{id} returns the full item plus 'related' (up to 4 siblings, same category, self excluded). Blog cards still use testID feed-blog-{id} (slug-based route /blog/<slug>), non-blog cards use feed-item-{id}. For reliable chip tap in Playwright, use JS .click() not Playwright force click — this is a web-automation limitation, not an app bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — original bug (non-tappable feed cards + missing detail route) is fully resolved. feed.tsx now wraps non-blog items in TouchableOpacity with testID feed-item-{id} navigating to router.push('/feed-item/${id}'). New screen app/feed-item/[id].tsx calls api.feedItem which hits GET /api/feed/{id}. All review-request bullet points pass.
